New York: the district just got a free rush option.

GIA is bringing back free next-day service on its Diamond Grading Report and Diamond Dossier for natural D-to-Z diamonds, for retailers submitting to its New York and Carlsbad labs, Nov. 9 through Dec. 15. Code HOLIDAY goes on the memo and box; the limit is 5 stones per client, per day.
